snippet.title: Bible Puzzle: Christian Game #orgames #bible #story
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3175310?utm_source=youtube-en-US
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.orgames.biblejigsawpuzzle&utm_source=youtube-en-US
iPhone/iPad: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/my-bible-puzzle/id6740878391?utm_source=youtube-en-US
...
Discover the beauty of the Scripture, one piece at the time.
Solve stunning puzzles inspired by the Bible and uncover the story with every image.
Each puzzle unlocks a short video with the message behind the scene.
Challenge friends, climb the leaderboards and enjoy a meaningful journey together!
Bible Puzzle, now available on GooglePlay and AppStore! Play on Steam and continue playing on your mobile phone!
